import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { users } from "./users";
import { changesetComments } from "./changeset_comments";
import { changesetTags } from "./changeset_tags";
import { currentNodes } from "./current_nodes";
import { currentRelations } from "./current_relations";
import { currentWays } from "./current_ways";
import { nodes } from "./nodes";
import { relations } from "./relations";
import { ways } from "./ways";

export const changesets = defineTable("changesets", {
    columns: {
        id: col.bigserial({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
        userId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).notNull(),
        createdAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }).notNull(),
        minLat: col.integer(),
        maxLat: col.integer(),
        minLon: col.integer(),
        maxLon: col.integer(),
        closedAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }).notNull(),
        numChanges: col.integer().notNull().default(0),
        numCreatedNodes: col.integer().notNull().default(0),
        numModifiedNodes: col.integer().notNull().default(0),
        numDeletedNodes: col.integer().notNull().default(0),
        numCreatedWays: col.integer().notNull().default(0),
        numModifiedWays: col.integer().notNull().default(0),
        numDeletedWays: col.integer().notNull().default(0),
        numCreatedRelations: col.integer().notNull().default(0),
        numModifiedRelations: col.integer().notNull().default(0),
        numDeletedRelations: col.integer().notNull().default(0)
    },
    relations: {
        user: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        changeset_comments: rel.hasMany(() => changesetComments),
        changeset_tags: rel.hasMany(() => changesetTags),
        current_nodes: rel.hasMany(() => currentNodes),
        current_relations: rel.hasMany(() => currentRelations),
        current_ways: rel.hasMany(() => currentWays),
        nodes: rel.hasMany(() => nodes),
        relations: rel.hasMany(() => relations),
        ways: rel.hasMany(() => ways),
        users: rel.manyToMany(() => users, { through: "changesets_subscribers", targetKey: "subscriber_id" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
